- `check.Suite` interface with `SetUpSuite`, `TearDownSuite`, `SetUpTest`, `TearDownTest`

GO ?= go
PKG ?= ./...

.PHONY: test test-verbose cover fmt vet tidy

test:
	$(GO) test $(PKG)

test-verbose:
	$(GO) test -v $(PKG)

cover:
	$(GO) test -coverprofile=coverage.out $(PKG)
	$(GO) tool cover -func=coverage.out

fmt:
	$(GO) fmt $(PKG)

vet:
	$(GO) vet $(PKG)

tidy:
	$(GO) mod tidy

The suite in `store/store_test.go:19` demonstrates all the gocheck features:
- Suite lifecycle: `SetUpSuite` / `TearDownSuite` (store_test.go:25)
- Per-test setup/teardown: `SetUpTest` / `TearDownTest` with an isolated `c.MkDir()` fixture (store_test.go:33)
- Rich assertions: `c.Assert`, `c.Check`, `Equals`, `IsNil`, `c.Log`

Run with `make test` or `go test -v ./...`. Change the module path (`example.com/gocheckdemo`) if you have a real repo URL. Note: I installed Go to `/tmp/opencode/go/bin` since it wasn't present.
